dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 12, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**AL East Powerhouses Fall to Rivals**

Yesterday's MLB action saw several teams fall to their divisional rivals. In the American League, the Baltimore Orioles were edged out by the Minnesota Twins 5-7, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs. Meanwhile, the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, thanks in part to Liam Hicks' three-hit, three-RBI performance. In the National League, the Chicago Cubs dominated the Washington Nationals 12-6, with Alex Bregman hitting three home runs and driving in seven runs.

**Pitching Dominance**

Several pitchers stood out on the mound yesterday. Luis Castillo threw a complete game shutout for the Chicago White Sox, striking out 10 in a 5-0 win over the Cincinnati Reds. Eric Lauer also had a strong outing, allowing just one run over 6.1 innings in the Los Angeles Dodgers' 4-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals. In the National League, Tyler Mahle pitched six scoreless innings for the Atlanta Braves, who defeated the New York Mets 6-3.

**Home Run Barrage**

Home runs were plentiful yesterday, with several players hitting multiple home runs. Alex Bregman led the way with three, all of which came in the Cubs' win over the Nationals. Trent Grisham also homered twice, helping the New York Yankees defeat the Seattle Mariners 10-5. Other notable home run hitters included Corbin Carroll, who hit his 18th of the season for the Arizona Diamondbacks, and Josh Bell, who hit his first home run of the season for the Baltimore Orioles.
